Measures taken by the Department to ease the process of filing of patents in the 
country: 
 
i. Amendments in Rules 
 
After taking into account feedback from various stakeholders, the Patents Rules were 
amended in 2016, 2017, 2019 and 2020 to achieve the objective of removing procedural 
inconsistencies and unnecessary steps in processing of applications to speed up 
grant/registration and final disposal. The procedures are now more compact, time -bound, 
user-friendly and compatible for e -transactions. Filing and processing of patent 
applications is made affordable for Start-ups and Small entities.  
 
ii. Modernization of patent offices and use of IT & technology.  
 
During last 5 years, there has been a steady switchover from manual to computerized 
system of processing of applications, upgradation of infrastructure, augmentation of 
technical manpower, computerisation, re-engineering of the process work -flow, database 
up-gradation and IT enablement of patent offices, improved management of intellectual 
property (IP) related information, creation of stronger public interface and revamping of 
the routine functioning of IP offices. This is also evident from following initiatives: 
  
 Paperless electronic processing implemented in Patent Office  
 E-filing of applications in Patents, which is available 24x7, has increased to more than 
91% in Patents. 10% rebate is provided on onl ine filing of Patents applications to 
increase online filings. 
 Email as a mode of service has been implemented in all patent office transactions. 
 Online delivery of Certificates of Grant of Patent in digital format implemented. 
 Registration of Patent Agent s and issuance of certificate for registration of Patent 
Agents is made online.  
 Periodic publication of list of First Examination Reports (FER) issued by the Patent 
Office. 
 Video-conferencing - Hearing of contested cases in Patents is done through Video-
conferencing from applicant’s place, thereby removing the requirement of visiting the 
Patent Office by the applicant. 
 SMS Alert - The facility launched to help the applicants to get alerts and updates 
regarding critical time -related events for patent processing so as to facilitate the 
applicants to submit response in time.  
 Dynamic Website and Information dissemination - The IPO website has been 
redesigned to improve contents and ease of access and make it more interactive, 
informative and easy to navig ate. IP data on real -time basis is available in respect of 
filing and processing of Patents applications. The website provides login -free Search 
facility for hassle-free dissemination of IP information to stakeholders. 
 WIPO services - WIPO CASE, i.e., Centr alized Access to Search and examination, 
WIPO Digital Access Service (DAS), WIPO Publish services, WIPO -IPCCAT, a 
202

categorization assistance tool for the International Patent Classification (IPC) system 
implemented in Patent office.  
  
iii. Manpower Augmentation 
 
The Department regularly reviews the manpower strength of patent offices with the 
Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trademarks (CGPDTM) office. In this regard, 
recruitment for 200 posts of Examiners of Patents & Designs concluded in the year 
2020. Promotions to various posts, as per the existing recruitment rules, are done on 
regularly. 
 
Examiners and Controllers in Patents are recruited in 16 different fields of inventions to 
deal with subject -wise applications received. Apart from initial induc tion trainings after 
the appointment and/or promotion, technical manpower in Patents and Trademarks is 
continuously given trainings/refresher courses for improvements in skills for examination 
and grant/registration of IP applications at RGNIIPM, Nagpur an d also at foreign IP 
Offices.  
 
iv. Expedited Examination 
 
The facility of Expedited Examination has been provided for patent applications filed by 
Startups and for applications where the Applicant has selected Indian Patent office as 
ISA/IPEA for his PCT appl ication. The Expedited Examination system has been further 
extended for patent applications to 8 more categories of Applicants w.e.f. 17 -09-2019 by 
amending the Patents Rules. New categories include SME, Female applicants, 
Government Departments, instituti ons established by a Central, Provincial or State Act, 
which is owned or controlled by the Government, Government Company, an institution 
wholly or substantially financed by the Government and applicants under PPH. Under the 
Expedited Examination System, m ost applications regarding grant of patents have been 
decided within about one year of filing Request for Expedited Examination as compared 
to the period of few years required in case of normal examination route.  
 
v. Feedback Mechanism 
 
The mechanism to lodge feedback/suggestions/complaints in respect of issues related to 
functioning of the IP offices has been set up in IPO website for the benefit of stakeholders. 
A team acts promptly on stakeholders’ suggestions/grievances and communicat e 
appropriate response through e-mail.  
 
vi. Initiatives for Startups: 
 
The Department has launched “Scheme for Facilitating Startups Intellectual Property 
Protection” (SIPP) for encouraging innovation and creativity of Startups. The SIPP 
Scheme was started on  pilot basis in 2016 for one year to help startups in filing and 
subsequent processing of their applications in Patents, Designs and Trademarks, as startups 
have limited resources and expertise in IPR processing. The scheme was in force up till 
March 31, 2 020 and has been further extended till March 2023. Under the scheme, the 
Government bears the entire cost of the facilitator/ lawyer or agent who assists the Startup 
file for any number of Patents, Trademarks or Designs.  
203

For effective implementation of th e scheme, facilitators have been empaneled by the 
Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trademarks (CGPDTM). Currently, more than 
900 facilitators have been registered with the office of CGPDTM.  
 
Further, an 80% rebate is provided to Startups on Pate nt filing fees. They can also avail 
the special facility of expedited examination of their patent applications.  
 
The SIPP scheme has been successful in promoting awareness amongst Start-ups to adopt 
IPRs and assisting them in protecting their innovations in the emerging technologies by 
providing access to high -quality IP services and resources, through the services of 
facilitators. 
 
vii) Initiatives for Small Entities and Educational Institutions 
 
Filing and processing fees for patent applications by small  entities and educational 
institutions has been reduced to 80% as compared to large entities. As a result, the patent 
filing and processing fees for small entities and educational institutions is now at par with 
the fees for individual applicants and Start-ups.

a hub for manufacturing, design, and innovation. Continuous efforts are made

nearly 58 percent of the FDI reported in the last 21 years (US$ 763.83 
billion).  This indicates increasing inclination of global companies to set up their 
business in India. 
 
Government has taken various other steps  in addition to ongoing schemes to 
boost domestic and foreign investments in India. These include measures to 
reduce compliance burden for indu stry, opportunities under National 
Infrastructure Pipeline, Reduction in Corporate Tax, Easing liquidity problems 
of NBFCs and Banks, Policy measures to boost domestic manufacturing through 
Public Procurement Orders, Phased Manufacturing Programme (PMP), e tc.

1175  SHRI M.V. SHREYAMS KUMAR: 
 
Will the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC 
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether Government is aware of any incidents of black-marketing of essential commodities 
during the COVID-19 pandemic; 
(b) if so, the details thereof; 
(c) whether Government took relevant measures to curb black-marketing during the Covid-19 
pandemic; 
(d)       if so, the details thereof; and  
(e)  if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE  
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION 
(SHRI ASHWINI KUMAR CHOUBEY) 
 
(a) to (e)   : The Essential Commodities Act, 1955 empowers the Government to regulate prices, 
production, supply, distribution etc. of essential commodities for maintaining or increasing their 
supplies and for securing their equitable distribution and availability at fair prices. Most of the powers 
under the Act have been delegated by the Central Government to the State Governments with the 
direction that they shall exercise these powers. The Prevention of Black-marketing and Maintenance 
of Supplies of Essential Commodities Act, 1980 is complementary to the EC Act, 1955. It is being 
implemented through the State Governments/UT Administrations for the prevention of illegal and 
unethical trade practices like hoarding and black-marketing of essential commodities etc.

ster of CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION 
 be pleased to state: 
(a) the number of warehouses currently operating in Andhra Pradesh for storage of
foodgrains, district-wise and the number of farmers benefitted from the said warehouses;
(b) the capacity of these warehouses and whether it is adequate for the storage of
foodgrains procured from farmers in Andhra Pradesh; and
(c) whether Government plans to set up more warehouses in Andhra Pradesh?
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND 
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION 
(SHRI ASHWINI KUMAR CHOUBEY) 
(a): As on 01.01.2022, 40 warehouses owned & hired by Food Corporation of India (FCI) 
are operating in Andhra Pradesh. District-wise details are Annexed. 
Further, 8.03 Lakh farmers were benefited in Andhra Pradesh during KharifMarketing 
Season (KMS) 2020-21 procurement season. 
(b): Combined capacity of warehouses operated by FCI (11.02 LMT) and the State 
Agencies (19.07 LMT) for storage o( central pool stocks is 30.09 LMT, which is adequate to 
store foodgrains procured from farmers in Andhra Pradesh. 
(c): At present, there is no plan to construct warehouses in Andhra Pradesh by FCI.

ALTERNATIVES TO PLASTIC PACKAGING OF FOOD COMMODITIES 
 
 
1178  SHRI SANJAY SINGH: 
 
Will the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC 
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether Government has planned alternatives to plastic packaging of food 
products; 
(b) if so, the details thereof, along with the action plan for the same; and 
(c)  if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE  
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION 
(SHRI ASHWINI KUMAR CHOUBEY) 
(a) to (c) : The draft Regulations on the Extended Producer Responsibility for plastic packaging under 
Plastic Waste Management Rules, 2016, has been notified by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and 
Climate Change, Government of India, on 6th October, 2021, for public consultation. The draf t 
regulation proposes to mandate reuse, minimum level of recycling of plastic packaging waste, use of 
recycled plastic content, and environmentally sound management of plastic waste. The draft regulation 
seeks to strengthen circular economy of plastic packaging waste, promote development of new 
alternatives to plastics and sustainable plastic packaging. 
The Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises has taken steps to encourage transition 
from single use plastic items to alternate materials.  NITI Aayog has already constituted a Committee to 
find out/develop an alternative product to plastic. The Ministry of Environment, Forest and climate 
change has shared with States/UTs an indicative Action Plan for elimination of identified single use 
plastics.  
 
 
 
 
243

 
 
 
Under the Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations, 2018, materials such as Paper & 
Board, Glass, metal & metal alloys and plastics are permitted as food contact material. 
Further, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has taken measures to accommodate 
environmental friendly and alternatives to plastic packaging materials as per details given below: 
i.  issued guidelines for use of bamboo as food contact material; 
ii. allowed serving drinking water in paper sealed reusable glass bottles for captive use within 
the hotel premises subject to certain conditions;  
iii. allowed use of other packaging materials (Paper and board materials/Glass/Metal and 
Metal Alloys ) for packing of drinking water, other than plastics that are used currently; 
iv. allowed the use of recycled plastics as food contact materials along with the relevant 
guidelines for acceptance criteria for recycled PET resin 
for food contact application.

1183 SHRI JOHN BRITTAS:

( c) if so, the detail.s of the incentives provided to the millers, State-wise?

THE MINISTER OF STATE CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND

(SHRI ASHWINI KUMAR CHOUBEY) 
(a): Government of India approved the Centrally Sponsored Pilot Scheme on "Fortification of 
Rice & its Distribution under Public Distribution System" for a period of 3 years beginning in 
2019-20 with total outlay of Rs. 174.64 Cr. The Pilot Scheme focuses on 15 districts across 15 
states, preferably 1 district per State. Out of 15 States which consented for the Pilot Scheme, so

Chhattisgarh, Uttar Pradesh, Odisha, Telangana, Madhya Pradesh, Uttarakhand and Jharkhand 
have reported distribution of fortified rice in their identified districts under the pilot scheme. So 
far 3.64 Lakh Metric Ton (LMT) of fortified rice has been distributed under the Pilot Scheme. 
(b) to ( c ): The incremental cost @ 73 paise per Kg is uniformly reimbursed by the States/UTs
to the Millers for production of fortified rice and shared between the Centre and the States/UTs
in the ratio of90:10 in case ofNorth-East, Hilly and Island States/UTs and 75:25 in case of rest
of the States.

(a):  Government is engaged in broadening and deepening the electronics manufacturing

 As on January 31, 2022, twenty (20) applications have been received and approved under

(c):     The chip shortage has impacted many industries worldwide with auto and consumer 
electronics industries among the most affected sectors. The shortage first emerged after the 
Covid-19 pandemic, due to lockdowns and restrictions. The supply side problem has transformed

of electronic goods across various segments. Industry estimates indicate an impact of 5% to 7% 
on the manufacturing in India depending on various sectors.

ecosystem and ensure that, it in- turn catalyses India’s rapidly expandin g electronics 
manufacturing and innovation ecosystem. This vision of AtmaNirbharta in electronics & 
semiconductors was given further momentum by the Union Cabinet chaired by the Hon’ble 
Prime Minister approving the Semicon India programme with a total outlay of INR 76,000 crore

programme aims to provide financial support to companies investing in semiconductors, display

presence in the global electronics value chains.

1191.  DR. AMAR PATNAIK:  
 
Will the Minister of ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to 
state: 
 
(a) the ‘authorized agencies’ identified by Government that are permitted to send notifications 
regarding unlawful content to intermediaries under IT Rules, 2021;  
(b) whether the ‘inter -departmental committee’ under rule 14 has been  appointed and met since 
its appointment; and  
(c) whether there are any penal consequences for non-compliance with Part-III of the 
Intermediary Guidelines? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
 (SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
 
(a):The Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) 
Rules, 2021 provides for removal of any unlawful information from the concerned intermediary 
platforms, on being notified by the appropriate Government or its authorize d agency. The 
authorised agencies are the notified agency(ies) of the appropriate Government ( State and 
Central Government), responsible for administration of the extant law. 
 
(b):  The Inter-Departmental Committee, as mandated by rule 14 of the IT Rules,   2021 has been 
constituted  and has met twice till January, 2022.  
 
 
(c):  Under Part-III of IT Rule, 2021, the publishers of online curated content (OTT platforms) 
and publishers of news and current affairs content on digital media are required to adhere to 
Code of Ethics prescribed under the Rules. Any violation of Code of ethics by such publishers 
will be addressed by the three-tier grievance redressal mechanism. Level-II (Self Regulating 
Body) and Level-III (Oversight Mechanism of Central Government) of the grievance redressal 
mechanism while addressing the grievance for violation of code of ethics by such publishers may 
recommend following:- 
 
(a) warning, censuring, admonishing or reprimanding the publishers; or  
(b) requiring an apology by the publishers; or  
(c) requiring such publishers to include a warning card or a disclaimer; or  
265

(d) in case of online curated content, directing the publisher to —(i) reclassify ratings of 
relevant content; or (ii) edit synopsis of relevant content; or (iii) make appropriate

(a): Government of India ‟s goal is to make India a significant design and manufacturing hub as

goods export has grown from USD 5.9 billion in 2014-15 to USD 10.6 billion in 2020-21. The

incentivize domestic value addition under „Make in India‟ and „AtmaNirbhar Bharat‟ initiative,

tariff support to goods being manufactured in India. In accordance with this policy, the Most 
Favoured Nation (MFN) rates of Basic Customs Duty (BCD) have been increased in recent years

incorporated in an export product. As per the Manufacture and Other Operations in Warehouse

deferment with no interest liability. There is no investment threshold or export obligation. The

MISLEADING INFORMATION ON SOCIAL MEDIA 
 BY NEIGHBOURING COUNTRIES  
 
 
1198.   SHRI K.R.N.   RAJESHKUMAR:  
 
Will the 
Minister of ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY  be pleased to 
state: 
 
(a) whether several neighbouring countries, their media and social media are indulging in 
misleading and incorrect propaganda about the policies and actions of our Government and 
if so, the details thereof and the reaction of Government thereto;  
(b) the steps being taken by Government to provide reliable information on such policies and 
actions; and  
(c) the steps taken/being taken by Government to prevent people from falling prey to the 
campaigns by several neighbouring countries under which misleading and false information 
is provided? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
 (SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
 
(a): Yes, Sir. Cyberspace being virtual, borderless and anonymous, anyone can post, share, 
communicate any message from anywhere across the world at any time. As internet expands and 
delivers many benefits to citizens, the Government is also aware of growing phenomena of  users 
harms caused by fake news and mis -information on some social media intermediaries/ 
publishers’ platforms including those supported by the state actors.  
 
(b) and (c): The Government is committed to ensure that the Internet in India is Open, Safe & 
Trusted and Accountable for all users. Government has taken several steps to address the 
challenges of mis -information and rumors spreading via various online media platforms 
including social media, news channel and other online portals. These, inter alia, 
include: 
 
 
(i) Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), on 25.02.2021 has notified 
the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 
2021 under the Information Technology Act (IT Act), 2000. These Rules require that the 
intermediaries follow certain due diligence as prescribed. Intermediaries are required to 
287

publish privacy policy and terms of use of their platform. They are also required to inform 
their users not to host, display, upload, modify, p ublish, transmit, update or share any 
information that is harmful, objectionable, and unlawful in any way. In addition, they are also 
required to remove any unlawful information,  prohibited under  any law, as and when 
brought to their  
 
 
 
 
 
knowledge either through a court order or through a notice by appropriate government or its 
agency. The Rules also require that publishers of news and current affairs, shall observe the 
Code of Ethics which includes adherence to : 
 
(a) Norms of Journalistic Conduct of the Press Council of India under the Press Council 
Act, 1978;  
(b) Programme Code under section 5 of the Cable Television Networks Regulation) Act, 
1995;  
(c) Content which is prohibited under any law for the time being in force shall not be 
published or transmitted. 
 
(ii) Under Section 69A of the IT Act, based on the requests received through designated 
nodal officers, Government orders blocking of any information generated, transmitted, 
received, stored or hosted in any computer resource in the interest of sovereignty and 
integrity of India, defence of India, security of the State, friendly relations with foreign states 
or public order or for preventing incitement to the commission of any cognizable offence 
relating to above. 
  
(iii) A Fact Check Unit has been setup under Press Information Bureau (PIB) of Ministry of 
Information and Broadcasting in November, 2019. This Unit takes cognizance of fake news 
both suo-motu and by way of queries sent by citizens on its portal or through e-mail and 
whatsapp. The Unit responds to the relevant queries with correct information when the same 
pertains to Central Government or forwards them to States/UTs in other cases. The Unit also 
maintains a twitter account @PlBFactcheck and posts cases of fake news, being busted, on 
the same on regular basis. The Fact Check Unit of PIB covers news on various 
mediaplatforms, including electronic media.

1203.   DR.VINAY P. SAHASRABUDDHE: 
 
Will the Minister of FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING  
be pleased to state: 
 
a). the basis on which the Ministry has fixed the interest rates of cattle insurance, the details thereof; 
  
b). whether the Ministry has sought feedback from farmers regarding the affordability and interest rates 
of the cattle insurance, if so, the details of action taken against them, if not, the reasons therefor; and 
  
c). whether the Ministry has taken any action to digitize the overall cattle insurance procedure on the 
lines of m-Kisan or Atmanirbhar Krishi, if so, the details of the portal/app developed, if not, the reasons

 Minister of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying be pleased to state:

(b) the reasons noted and identified for such decrease; 
 
(c) whether any assistance to the fishermen community is likely to be announced to meet the

reduction in post-harvest losses through improved infrastructure and transportation facilities, 
value addition and providing training and skill upgradation of fishers and fish farmers, upgrading 
and augmenting market and cold chain infrastructure and enhanced access to low cost working 
capital, etc. 
(d): The potential of marine fisheries resources available in Indian Exclusive Economic Zone is 
periodically revisited through Expert Committees constituted from time to time. The last such 
Working Group of Experts was constituted on 24 thAugust,
 2017 for revalidation of potential 
fishery resources available and to estimate the additional marine fisheries potential that could be 
harvested on a sustainable basis from different de pth, zones and regions of India’s sovereign  
waters. The Working Group has submitted its report on 26 th September, 2018, wherein potential 
yield of Indian 
EEZ is estimated as 5.31 million metric tonnes.

HEALTH CHECKS ON IMPORTED LIVESTOCK 
 
1207. SHRI RAM CHANDER JANGRA: 
 
Will the Minister of FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING  
be pleased to state: 
(a) whether there is any provision for the health check-up of livestock at the time of import by 
various Government or non- Government institutes, if so, the details thereof; 
(b) whether any provision to take action if the imported animals are found to be suffering  
from any disease; and  
(c) the country-wise details of the livestock imported during the last three years? 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING 
(SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA) 
 
(a) The Live-stock Importation Act, 1898 empowers the Government to make better provision for 
the regulation of the importation of live-stock which is liable to be affected by infectious or 
contagious disorders. In exercise of the power conferred by Section 3 of the Live-stock 
Importation Act, 1898 (9 of the 1898), all live animals are presently allowed only through the 
seaports or airports located at Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad (for pet dog, pet 
cat and Grand Parent Stock of Poultry only) and Bengaluru (for pet dog, pet cat and Grand 
Parent Stock of Poultry only). Any other port of entry may also be notified by the Central 
Government from time to time. The import of live animals is subject to the fulfillment of a 
valid and authenticated Veterinary Certificate issued by the official veterinarian of the 
exporting country or country of origin as per Indian health protocol.  All the importers, before 
embarkment shall intimate the Quarantine Officer or Regional Officer, Animal Quarantine and 
Certification Station and will seek permission seven days in advance (relaxable up to three days 
in pressing circumstances) prior to actual shipment so that proper arrangement could be made 
in the quarantine premises wherever applicable. The importer has to submit the copies of all 
documents including valid licence issued by the Director General of Foreign Trade, 
authenticated Veterinary Certificate issued by the official veterinarian of the exporting country 
for getting permission from Animal Quarantine Officer or Regional Officer of the respective 
port of entry.  
 
 
 
306

 
  
 
  The imported animals shall be subjected to post import quarantine for a specified period as 
indicated in the health certificate applicable for import of a particular animal at a given time. 
The live animals, during the quarantine period, shall be liable to undergo diagnostic tests for 
the diseases as stipulated in the post import guidelines in the animal health protocol issued by 
the Government of India or as deemed necessary by the Government of India for protection of 
human and animal health under the supervision of Animal Quarantine Officer at the cost of 
importer/owner. 
 
(b) If the Regional Officer or Quarantine officer, during the quarantine of such animal(s), finds that 
the animal(s) imported contains any exotic or other infectious diseases even though present in 
the country, then the Regional Officer or Quarantine Officer may, by giving a notice to the 
importer through a verifiable means, to deport or re-export the animal(s) to the country of 
origin within fifteen days or within such period as further may be allowed. Where the importer 
fails to take action as directed by Regional Officer or Quarantine Officer such animal(s) within 
such time as may be allowed for the purpose, the Regional Officer or Quarantine officer may 
destroy the animal(s) at the cost of importer or owner. 
 
(c) As per available data, the country-wise details of the livestock imported during the last three 
years are appended as Annexure-I, II and III.

CAG AUDIT OF NATIONAL DAIRY PLAN AND NDDB  
1209 PROF. MANOJ KUMAR JHA: 
 
Will the Minister of FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING   
be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the amount and details of wasteful expenditure pointed out by CAG in its audit of the 
National Dairy Plan (NDP) implemented by National Dairy Development Board (NDDB); 
 
(b) the point-wise clarification provided by the Department of Animal Husbandry and 
Dairying (DAHD) to (a) above; and 
 
(c) the reasons why Department of Economic Affairs is yet to act on the request of 
DAHD sent on 13.03.202 0 to audit the accounts of NDDB under section 14(2) of the CAG 
Act1971? 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING 
(SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA) 
 
(a) The CAG team hascommunicated  a draft Para on wasteful expenditure of Rs. 2.74 
Crore in Pilot Doorstep Artificial Insemination Delivery Services (PAIDS) sub project of 
ShreejaMahila Milk Producer Company and requested point-wise clarification. 
 
(b
) In cognizance to reply of NDDB, this Department vide letter dated 25 November 
2021 has sent point-wise clarification to the Indian Audit & Accounts Department. A brief 
account of the point-wise reply sent is given below: 
 
i) On CAGs point on sanctioning of project without clearly defining the area of 
operation between Shreeja MMPC and Andhra Pradesh Livestock Development 
Agency (APLDA) leading to duplication of activities, it was replied that under NDP 
only a pilot doorstep Artificial insemination (AI) programme was taken up in Chittor 
district by Shreeja Milk producer Company (SMPC). As per scientific norms, on an 
average2-3 times AI is required per breedable bovine for one conception; 
accordingly,
 the actual coverage by APLDA was estimated at 45% only instead of 
90% claimed. The SMPC was to cover additional 24% of breedable population only 
on scientific basis to ensure greater conception rate and reduce dependence on 
318

Government subsidy. The pilot model which was proposed to be set up by SMPC 
was aimed at recovering the full charge of the AI delivery service by the end of 6 
years unlike other AI Sponsored Programmes under various Government schemes 
and hence it did not overlap with schemes that offer subsidised AI delivery services 
requiring grant on a continuing basis. 
ii
) On continuation of project implementation activities by SMPC till March 2017 
despite recommendation of Regional Review (RR) meeting held in July 201 6 raised 
by CAG, it was replied that Central Government did not request NDDB to close the 
project implementation. However, till the RR meeting held,  out of total sanctioned 
amount of Rs 8.07 Cr to be utilized during 2015-16 & 2016-17, only Rs 2.74 Cr was 
utilised to complete the already ongoing activities in consideration of the decision 
made by the RR. 
iii) In case of CAG comments that achievement with regard to conception rate was 
neither holistic nor representative as other parameters like total AI done, coverage of 
villages and MAIT deployed did not achieve the targeted performance; it was rep
lied 
that the World Bank in its evaluation report had acknowledged that a higher 
conception rate was achieved. The report confirms that the quality of AI can be 
significantly improved and is testimony to holistic and representative conception rate. 
iv) CAG commented that the audit comments is not on the project as a whole and is on 
sub-project and World Bank report does not justify improper planning and execution 
of an individual project. In this regard, it was replied that for success of project, it is 
important to achieve Project Development Objectives (PDOs) and under NDP all the 
PDO level indicators were achieved. 
 
(c) The question does not arise, as the Department of Economic Affairs vide O.M. No. 
8(2)-B(R&C)/2022 dated 04.02.2022 have sent a reply to the Department of AHD.

Blue Revolution in Andhra Pradesh 
 
1210.    Shri Prabhakar Reddy Vemireddy: 
               
   Will the Minister of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying be pleased to state:  
 (a)  the details of projects sanctioned in Andhra Pradesh for promotion, productivity, post 
harvest infrastructure and address the critical gaps in fish production; 
(b)  the details of funds sanctioned, released an d utilized so far in the State; 
(c)  the special attention being paid to this State and its fishermen, since Andhra Pradesh is 
the leading State in aqua exports; and 
(d)  the welfare measures being provided to fishermen in Andhra Pradesh under Blue Revolution? 
 
ANSWER 
 
 THE MINISTER OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING 
 
(SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA) 
(a) to (c): The Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying is 
implementing a flagship scheme of Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) : A scheme 
to bring about Blue Revolution through sustainable and responsible development of fisheries sector 
in India with highest ever investment of Rs. 20050 crore with effect from the financial year 2020-
21in all the States/UTs including in Andhra Pradesh. Under PMMSY, total investment of Rs.1955 
crore envisaged in Andhra Pradesh. This Department during the financial years 2020-21 and 2021-
22 has accorded approval to the fisheries development proposals of Government of Andhra Pradesh 
at a total cost of Rs. 657.11 crore and so far released central funds of Rs. 108.95 crore to the State 
Government for development of fisheries in the State.
 Major components approved under PMMSY 
to the Government of Andhra Pradesh for promotion, productivity, post 
harvest infrastructure and address the critical gaps in fish production are; (i) establishment of brood 
bank and hatchery, (ii) Re-circulatory Aquaculture System, (iii) Open sea cages, (iv) Reservoir 
cages, (v) construction of ponds, (vi) Deep sea fishing vessels (vii) Seaweed cultivation, (viii) 
Marketing infrastructure such as insulated vehicle, live fish vending centre, motor cycle with ice 
box, three wheeler with ice box, fish kiosk, value add enterprises, e-platform for e-trading and e-
marketing. The Government of Andhra Pradesh has taken up implementation of these approved 
proposals and reported utilization of the central funds of Rs. 36.57 crore till date.  
 
(d): The PMMSY scheme has provision for welfare related activity namely Livelihood and 
nutritional support for socio-economically backward active traditional fishers families for 
conservation of fish resources during fishing ban/lean period. Under PMMSY, 98360 numbers of 
active traditional fishers’ families benefitted in Andhra Pradesh during 2021-22

AMBULANCE NETWORK FOR VETERINARY NEEDS 
 
1211.  SHRI SUBHAS CHANDRA BOSE PILLI: 
 
Will the Minister of FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY & DAIRYING  
be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government seeks to formulate a Central Government run ambulance 
network for veterinary needs as present in many States like Andhra Pradesh; and  
 
(b)  if so, what would be the procedure for infrastructure set up and allocation of funds? 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY & DAIRYING 
(SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA) 
 
(a) & (b) Government provides financial assistance to all States / Union Territories 
(UTs) under Livestock Health and Disease Control Programme. From 2021-22, there 
is a focus on veterinary healthcare services at the farmer’s doorstep through Mobile 
Veterinary Units (MVUs). The MVUs may run on Public-Private Partnership (PPP) 
mode with Government providing for infrastructure and manpower outsourced by 
Implementing Agency including cooperatives and Milk Unions. Call Centre , 
established by States / UTs, will act as a pivot whilst rendering mobile veterinary 
services. While 100% central funds will be towards procurement & customization of 
mobile veterinary units, recurring operational expenditure would be shared in the 
ratio of 90
:10 for North Eastern & Himalayan States and 60% for other States, while 
it is 100% for UTs.

IMPLEMENTATION OF NATIONAL DAIRY PLAN 
1212. SHRI T.G. VENKATESH: 
 
Will the Minister of FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING  
be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether the attention of the Government is drawn to the implementation of National Dairy Plan 
(NDP) 
in the country; 
 
(b) if so, the details thereof; and 
 
(c) the details of the initiatives taken by Government to help increase productivity of milch animals and 
provide rural milk producers access to the organized milk-processing sector? 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING 
(SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA) 
 
(a) and (b)  Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Government of India has implemented 
National Dairy Plan Phase I (NDP-I), a Central Sector Scheme (CSS) with an  outlay of Rs. 2242 
Crore during March 2012 to Nov 2019 across 18 major dairying states. The twin objectives of NDP- I 
was to enhancing productivity of milch animals and providing market access to milk producers. The 
implementation of NDP-I was ended with the financial closure in March 2020. 
The implementation of NDP- I have established the fact that a scientifically planned integrated 
approach towards dairy development can indeed be successful in a large and diverse country like India. 
NDP-I was able to make available more than 2,456 High Genetic Merit Bulls to A & B graded semen 
stations across the country which propelled the production of quality disease-free semen. The project 
also contributed towards lowering the cost of feeding per kg of milk resulting in increase of net daily 
income of milk producers by Rs 25.52. Market access was provided to more than 16.8 lakh 
additionally enrolled milk producers of which 7.65 lakh are women members. The project covered 
around 59 lakh beneficiaries across 97,000 villages. Cooperative development initiatives under the 
322

NDP-I provided additional, reliable income for tribal dairy farmers and improved their overall socio-
economic conditions – especially the marginalized and most vulnerable. More transparent procurement 
and payment under Village Based Milk Procurement System (VBMPS) led to better prices. 
(c) This Department is implementing Rashtriya Gokul Mission (RGM) schemes to increase 
productivity of milch animals and the following schemes are implemented to provide rural milk 
producers with great access to the organised milk-processing sector:  
1. National Programme for Dairy Development (NPDD) 
2. Dairy processing and Infrastructure Development Fund (DIDF) 
3. Supporting Dairy Cooperatives and Farmer Producer Organizations engaged in dairy activities 
(SDCFPO):  
4.  Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF)

1216. SHRI RAM CHANDER JANGRA:       
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:

of laboratories which are operational; 
  
(b) whether all these laboratories have been established according to the international 
standards; 
 
(c) if not, whether any scheme is under consideration for upgradation of these laboratories, 
if so, the details thereof; and

Haryana in the coming five years?

THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
  
(a) & (b) : There are 726 Testing Laboratories for food products in the country as per study 
conducted by Ministry of Food Processing Industries in 2020 -21 and these Laboratories are 
operational at different levels of operation and testing of food products. Out of these, 585 food 
testing laboratories have obtained Accreditation as per the international standards i.e. ISO/IEC 
17025/NABL.

financial assistance is provided to establis h/upgrade Food Testing Laboratories to meet with 
international standards i.e. ISO/IEC 17025/NABL. The three central sector schemes are (i) 
Food Safety and Quality Assurance Infrastructure implemented by Ministry of Food Processing 
Industries, (ii) Strength ening of Food Testing System in the Country including provision of 
Mobile Food testing Lab implemented by Food Safety and Standards Authority of India under 
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and (iii) 
Financial Assistance for Quality Development Scheme  implemented by Agricultural and 
Processed Food Products Export Development Authority under Ministry and Commerce and 
Industries.  
(d): Government of India does not establish any Food Testing Laboratory on its own. The 
proposal for Food testing Laboratories received are demand driven and there is no specific state 
wise target. The details of Food Testing Laboratories supported in the State of Haryana are at

PRODUCTION LINKED INCENTIVE SCHEME 
  
1219. SMT. SHANTA CHHETRI 
  
Will the Minister of Food Processing Industries be pleased to state: - 
  
(a) whether an outlay of Rs. 10,900 crores to support creation of global food manufacturing 
champions and support Indian brands of food products in international market has been planned 
by the Ministry under Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme; 
 
(b) if so, the details thereof, if not, the reasons therefor; and 
  
(c) how much of the outlay has been invested and progress of implementation year -wise 
and State-wise?  
  
 
ANSWER 
 
  
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
         
(a) to (c) : Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Food Processing Industry (PLISFPI) has 
been formulated by the Ministry as part of “Aatma Nirbhar Bharat Abhiyaan” for enhancing 
India's manufacturing capabilities and e nhancing exports with an outlay of Rs 10,900 crore. 
The scheme has three broad components. The first component relates to incentivizing 
manufacturing of four major food product segments viz. Ready to Cook/ Ready to Eat (RTC/ 
RTE) including millet -based foo ds, Processed Fruits & Vegetables, Marine Products and 
Mozzarella Cheese. The second component is intended for incentivizing Innovative/ Organic 
products of SMEs across all the above four food product segments including Free Range - Eggs, 
Poultry Meat and Egg Products.  The third component relates to support for branding and 
marketing abroad to incentivize the emergence of strong Indian brands. 
  
The scheme guidelines were notified on 2nd May, 2021 and EoI was issued for inviting 
applications under the scheme on 2 nd May, 2021 with closure date of application window as 
24th June, 2021.  A total of 60 applicants under Category-I, 12 applicants under Category-II and 
71 applicants under Category-III have been selected recently.

enterprises in the country. The scheme is operational for a period of five years from 2020-21 to 
2024-25 with an outlay of Rs 10,000 Crore. Support to upgrade existing units or setting up of 
new micro units for individuals is provided through a credit linked grant @ 35% with maximum 
grant of Rs. 10.00 lakhs. The Scheme also provides support to food processing  units of Self 
Help Groups (SHGs) / Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) / Cooperatives for credit linked 
subsidy@35%, Seed Capital to SHGs, Incubation Centre, Common Infrastructure, Marketing 
& Branding and Capacity Building.

ASSISTANCE TO FPIs IN KARNATAKA  
  
1223. SHRI IRANNA KADADI: 
  
Will the Minister of Food Processing Industries be pleased to state : 
  
(a) whether Government has provided assistance to Food Processing  Industries (FPIs) in 
Karnataka during the last two years and the current year; 
 
(b) if so, the details thereof, industry and location-wise; 
 
(c) whether Government has fixed any time limit for  accepting the proposals  and providing 
assistance; 
 
(d) if so, the details thereof; and 
 
(e) whether Government has taken any steps to reduce the prescribed time limit and if so, 
the details thereof?  
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
  
(a) to (e): The Ministry of Food Processing industries (MoFPI) has been implementing Central Sector 
umbrella scheme - Pradhan Mantri Kisan SAMPADA Yojana  (PMKSY) for overall growth and 
development of food processing sector across the country including Karnataka. Under component 
schemes of PMKSY, MoFPI provides mostly credit linked financial assistance (capital subsidy) in 
the form of grants-in-aid to entrepreneurs for setting up of food processing / preservation industries. 
So far, Ministry has approved 2 Mega Food Park projects, 16 Cold Chain projects, 4 Agro Processing 
Clusters, 18 Food Processing Units, 3 Creation of Backward & Forward Linkages Projects & 9 Food 
Test Laboratory projects in  Karnataka for assistance under corresponding component schemes of 
PMKSY. Details of these projects along with location is placed at Annexure. 
 
MoFPI is also implementing a Centrally Sponsored Scheme - PM Formalisation o f Micro 
Food Processing Enterprises Scheme (PMFME) for providing financial, technical and business 
support for setting up/upgradation of 2 lakh micro food processing enterprises across the country 
through credit linked subsidy during five years from 2020-21 to 2024-25 with an outlay of Rs. 10,000 
cr.  Out of this, a total of 11910 units have been allocated to Karnataka and Rs 49.93 Crore has been 
released to the state so far. 
 
PMKSY is not any region or state specific but demand driven and financial assista nce is 
provided to the eligible applicants selected on the basis of Expression of Interest (EoI) issued from 
time to time. Selection of suitable proposals is done regularly as per the Scheme guidelines, based on 
the merit, through a transparent appraisal p rocess as per the prefixed criteria. As selection process 
involves appraisal & scrutiny of proposals at multiple levels, including through Inter -Ministerial 
Approval Committee (IMAC), no specific time limit is prescribed in this regard in PMKSY, though 
MoFPI makes every effort for its expeditious disposal. Grants to assisted projects is disbursed 
immediately after achieving prescribed benchmarks within budgetary constraints.

SELLING OF TOP CROPS AT LOWER PRICE 
 
1224. SHRI NEERAJ SHEKHAR:  
 
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government is aware that farmers of Eastern Uttar Pradesh, particularly the 
districts of Ballia and Ghazipur produce Tomato, Onion and Potatoes (TOP) on large scale but 
they are compelled to sell it every year at price lower than the cost of production; 
  
(b) if so, the details of thereof; and 
 
(c) the details of steps Government would take to provide remunerative price to these tomato, 
onion and potato growing farmers of Eastern Uttar Pradesh during the current crop season? 
    
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
 
(a) to (c): Ballia and Ghazipur district of Utttar Pradesh are figuring in the list of major producing 
districts for onion only as per the Report titled “Horticulture Statistics at a Glance 2018” published 
by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare.   These districts are, accordingly, selected as 
eligible clusters/districts for onion crop as pe r the existing guidelines for the short term 
intervention under the Operation Greens scheme.     
 
The Ministry of Food Processing Industries provides transportation /storage subsidy @  
50% for notified fruits & vegetables  (including Tomato, Onion and Potato (TOP) crops) in 
selected clusters at the time of glut situation during harvest season under short term intervention. 
The provision of transportation/storage subsidy helps in evacuation of surplus production of crops 
from production centres to consumption centres and ensures price stabilization for farmers as well 
as consumers.   
 
The Ministry is also maintaining Market Intelligence & Early Warning System (MIEWS) 
Portal to keep watch on current prices of Tomato, Onion and Potato (TOP) crops through National 
Agricultural Cooperative Marketing Federation of India Ltd.  (NAFED) and , accordingly, low 
price alerts are issued to concerned States from time to time. 
 
The D/o Agriculture & Famers Welfare implements a Market Intervention Scheme (MIS) 
for procurement of agricultural and horticultural commodities which are perishable in nature and 
for which Minimum Support Price (MSP) is not announced. The scheme objective is to protect 
the growers of these commodities from making distress sale in the event of a bumper crop during 
the peak arrival period when prices tend to fall below the economic  levels/ cost of 
production.  The scheme is, however, implemented at the request of a State/ UT Administration 
which is ready to bear 50 % of the loss (25 % in case of NER), if any, incurred on its 
implementation.

 Minister of Heavy Industries be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the various initiatives undertaken by the Ministry and its constituent bodies towards 
ensuring Ease of Doing Business for the industries relevant to the mandate of Ministry, the 
details thereof; 
 
(b) whether the Ministry has documented the extent of ease brought to the industries in 
doing business through these initiatives, if so, the details thereof, if not, the reasons therefor; 
and

(SHRI KRISHAN PAL GURJAR) 
 
(a): Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) under the Ministry 
of Commerce & Industry, the nodal Department for providing Ease of Doing Business

aim to improve regulatory environment and facilitate doing business in India.   This is evident 
from three major initiatives spearheaded by DPIIT focusing on – World Bank’s Ease of Doing 
Business, State Business Reforms Action Plan and systematic approach to reduce co mpliance 
burden on businesses and citizens.   The steps taken intend to benefit all the sectors/industries 
of an economy, including the Heavy Industry.  
 
DPIIT regularly coordinates with nodal Ministries/Departments/States concerned to 
monitor the exercise for improving India’s ranking in World Bank’s Doing Business Report 
(DBR).  As a result of these efforts, India ranks 63 rd in the latest DBR, 2020 released in 
October, 2019, registering a jump of 14 ranks over its previous rank.  
DPIIT has been anchoring a dynamic reform exercise called Business Reforms Action 
Plan (BRAP), which ranks all the States and UTs in the country based on implementation of 
designated reform parameters. 
DPIIT is the Nodal Department for coordination with Ministries/Departments and 
States/UTs to reduce compliance burden on citizens and business activities.   The objective of 
this exercise is to improve Ease of Doing Business and Ease of Living by  Simplifying, 
Rationalizing, Digitizing and Decriminalizing Government to Business and Citi zen Interfaces 
across Ministries/States/UTs.  The key focus areas of the exercise are: 
a. Rationalization/Auto-renewal of licenses / certificates / permissions.

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (c) OF UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 
1239 ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 11.02.2022 BY DR. SASMIT PATRA REGARDING 
 PLANS OF INDIAN RAILWAYS 
 
(a) to (c) : Indian Railways have prepared a National Rail Plan (NRP) for India – 2030. The Plan is to 
create a ‘future ready’ Railway system by 2030.   The NRP is a imed to formulate strategies based on 
both operational capacities and commercial policy initiatives to increase modal share of the Railways 
in freight to 45%. The objective of the Plan is to create capacity ahead of demand, which in turn 
would also cater t o future growth in demand right up to 2050 and also increase the modal share of 
Railways to 45% in freight traffic and to continue to sustain it. To achieve this objective all possible 
financial models including Public Private Partnership (PPP) are being considered.  
As Indian Railways is the growth engine of the nation, NRP is aimed to reform Railways to make 
it more efficient, greener and modern which will translate into cheaper, safer and assured mode of 
transport to the common man be it in passenger or freight segment. To achieve this objective, 
following main features of the National Rail Plan have been identified:- 
 Formulate strategies based o n both operational capacities and commercial policy initiatives to 
increase modal share of the Railways in freight to 45%. 
 Reduce transit time of freight substantially by increasing average speed of freight trains to 
50Kmph. 
 As part of the National Rail Pl an, Vision 2024 has been launched for accelerated implementation 
of certain critical projects by 2024 such as 100% electrification, multi -tracking of congested routes, 
upgradation of speed to 160 kmph on Delhi -Howrah and Delhi-Mumbai routes, upgradation of speed 
to 130kmph on all other Golden Quadrilateral -Golden Diagonal (GQ/GD) routes and elimination of 
all Level Crossings on all GQ/GD route. 
 Identify new Dedicated Freight Corridors. 
 Identify new High Speed Rail Corridors. 
 Assess rolling stock requirement for passenger traffic as well as wagon requirement for freight. 
  Assess Locomotive requirement to meet twin objectives of 100% electrification (Green Energy) 
and increasing freight modal share. 
 Assess the total investment in capital that would be required along with a periodical break up. 
 Sustained involvement of the Private Sector in areas like operations and ownership of rolling 
stock, development of freight and passenger terminals, development/operations of track infrastructure 
etc.

2. Raw Material Supply Scheme;

1280.  SHRI K.J. ALPHONS: 
 
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:  
 
 
(a) the support being provided for technology upgradation in the textiles sector;  
 
(b) the support being provided for preservation of skills in tribal communities in textile manufacturing; 
and  
 
(c) how many tribal children have been trained in traditional tribal textile manufacturing with assistance 
from the Ministry? 
 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR TEXTILES  
(SMT. DARSHANA JARDOSH) 
 
 
(a): Ministry of Textiles is providing capital investment subsidy for eligible investment in 
technology upgradation across textile manufacturing sector under Amended Technology Upgradation 
Fund Scheme (ATUFS) implemented since 2016.  Financial support is also provided under National 
Handloom Development Programme for upgradation of looms and accessories to handloom weavers.

under National Handicraft Development Programme.  The new technologies developed by Central Silk

Sericulture Departments through beneficiary oriented components under Silk Samagra Scheme.

development scheme implemented by Ministry of Textiles promotes skilling and skill upgradation in 
traditional sectors of handlooms, handicraft, sericulture and jute.    Under SAMARTH, preference is 
given to the marginalized social groups like women, SC/ST, differently-abled persons, minorities, 
persons from the BPL category and 115 Aspirational Districts notified by the NITI Aayog.  A total of 
1,712 Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries have been provided skill training in traditional textile sector 
courses (Handloom -966, Handicraft-518, Sericulture -199 and Jute- 29) under SAMARTH.  In 
addition, a total of 4,820 tribal artisans have benefitted through 238 training programmes conducted by 
O/o Development Commissioner (Handicrafts) since 2018-19.

रहा  है । 
v. राष्ट्रीय आलेक्ट्रॉननक टोल  संग्रह (एनइटीसी ): राष्ट्रीय आलेक्ट्रॉननक टोल  संग्रह (एनइटीसी) प्रणाली 
ग्राहक को  अरएफअइिी (रेनियो फ्रीक्व ें सी अआिेंरटकफक े शन) प्रौद्योनगकी का  ईपयोग करक े  टोल  
पर  रुक े  नबना  राजमागज  पर  एनइटीसी सक्षम टोल  ललाजा  पर  आलेक्ट्रॉननक भुगतान  करने  में  सक्षम 
बनाती  है। एनइटीसी लेनदेन  की  मात्रा ऄप्रैल, 2017 में  74.1 लाख  से बढ़कर जनवरी , 2022 में  
2,310.1 लाख  हो गइ है। 
vi. भारत  नबल  भुगतान  प्रणाली: भारत  नबल भुगतान  प्रणाली (बीबीपीएस) ईपभोिाओं को  आंटरनेट  
बैंककग , मोबाआल  बैंककग , मोबाआल  ऐप, भीम -यूपीअइ अकद जैसे कइ  चैनलों  के  माध्यम से एक  
ऄन्‍तर  प्रचालनीय और  असानी  से सुलभ  अवती और  नबल  भुगतान  सेवा प्रदान करती  है। 
462

वतजमान  में , भारत  भर  में  20 श्रेनणयों के  नबलसज  को  बीबीपीएस पर  जोड़ा जा  रहा  है। बीबीपीएस 
में  नपछले  क ु छ वषों में  महत्वपूणज वृनि देखी गइ है, बीबीपीएस लेनदेन  की  मात्रा ऄक्टूबर, 2017 
में  7.6 लाख  से बढ़कर जनवरी , 2022 में  627.1 लाख  हो गइ है। 
vii. क्यूअर कोि  प्रौद्योनगकी को  तेजी  से ऄपनाना : नवमुद्रीकरण के  बाद, क्यूअर कोि  के  नलए  
थवीक ृ त बुननयादी  ढांचे में  जबरदथत  वृनि देखी गइ है। नतीजतन , क्यूअर अधाररत  भुगतान  
तेजी  से बढ़ रहे  हैं। ईपयोनगता नबल , ईंधन , ककराना , भोजन, यात्रा और  कइ  ऄन्य श्रेनणयों का  
भुगतान  करने  के  नलए  कोइ  भी क्यूअर कोि  को  थक ै न  ककया  जा  सकता  है। 
viii. बेहतर  गनत और  समय  पर  निलीवरी : नकद  भुगतान  के  नवपरीत , जो  ऄपने वाहक  की  गनत से 
यात्रा करता  है, निनजटल  भुगतान  वथतुतः तात्कानलक  हो सकता है, भले  ही प्रेषक और  प्राप्‍तकताज  
एक  ही शहर , नजले  या देश में  हों या न  हों। 
ix. सरकारी  प्रणाली में  बढ़ी पारदर्तशता: पहले  नकद  भुगतान  " लीक े ज " ( भुगतान  जो  पूणज रूप से 
प्राप्तकताज तक  नहीं  पहुंचता है) और  " घोस्‍ट" ( नकली ) प्राप्तकताजओं के  तहत थे , नवशेष रूप से 
सरकारी  हथतांतरण  द्वारा सामानजक सुरक्षा लाभों  के  संदभज में  । ऄब, भुगतान  के  निनजटल  तरीकों  
के  माध्यम से लाभ  सीधे लनक्षत लाभाथी ( प्रत्यक्ष लाभ  हथतांतरण ) के  खाते में  थथानांतररत  कर  
कदए जाते हैं। नवत्त वषज 2021-2022 के  दौरान  312 योजनाओं  के  तहत 4.6 लाख  करोड़ रुपये  
के  मूलय का  लेनदेन  िीबीटी के  माध्यम से ककया  गया है। 
x. सुरनक्षत और  नवश्‍वसनीय : नकद  भुगतान  प्राप्तकताजओं को  ऄक्सर न  क े वल  ऄपने  भुगतान  प्राप्त 
करने  के  नलए  काफी  दूरी तय करनी  पड़ती है, बनलक  वे चोरी  के  नलए  भी नवशेष रूप से 
संवेदनशील  होते हैं । भारत  भर  में  निनजटल  भुगतान  बहुत सुरनक्षत हैं - लेनदेन करने  के  नलए  
प्रमाणीकरण के  कइ  थतरों  की  अवश्यकता होती है। 
xi. निनजटल  भुगतान  का  वैश्वीकरण: भारत  का  थवदेशी रूप से नवकनसत  भीम -यूपीअइ ( भारत  
आंटरफ े स फॉर मनी -यूननफाआि पेमेंट्स आंटरफ े स) और  रुपे  कािज  निनजटल  भुगतान  को  सक्षम करने  
के  नलए  नवश्व थतरीय  ललेटफॉमज  हैं। वैनश्वक टेक -कदग्गज, गूगल ने  भी यूएस फ े िरल ररजवज  को  
निनजटल  भुगतान  के  नलए  भारत  के  यूपीअइ जैसे  ललेटफॉमज  की  नसफाररश  की  है। 
xii. ईधार : पहले  ऄथजव्यवथथा में  नकदी  का  वचजथव बना  रहता  था  नजससे  नागररक  की  नवत्तीय छाप 
थथानपत  करने  की संभावना  कम हो जाती  है। ऄब निनजटल भुगतान  क्र े निट सनहत औपचाररक  
नवत्तीय सेवाओं तक  नागररकों  की  पहुंच बढ़ाते हैं। छोटे पैमाने  के  ईद्यनमयों की  ऄक्सर 
औपचाररक  क्र े िेट तक  सीनमत  पहुंच होती है। बैंक  और  नइ  ऋण देने  वाली  क ं पननयां  निनजटल  
लेनदेन  पूवजवृत्‍त की  समीक्षा करने  और  नागररकों  को  ऋण देने  में  सक्षम होंगी। 
xiii. कफनटेक  को  बढ़ावा देना : कफनटेक  ने  पूरे निनजटल  भुगतान  पाररनथथनतकी  तंत्र को  लाभानन्वत 
करते  हुए पारदशी , सुरनक्षत, तेज  और  ककफायती  लागत  के  तंत्र को  सक्षम करक े  निनजटल  लेनदेन  
की  वृनि में  महत्वपूणज भूनमका  ननभाइ  है। कफनटेक  ने  व्‍यनि-से-व्‍यनि  (पी2पी) के  साथ -साथ  
व्‍यनि-से-व्‍यापारी (पी2एम ) भुगतानों में  वृनि करक े  निनजटल भुगतान   पेमेंट  पाररनथथनतकी  
तंत्र को  बदल  कदया है।

(क ) और  (ख) : भारत  सरकार  के  इलेक्ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना  प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्रालय (एमईआईटीवाई) ने  वषष  
2014 में 'निनजटल इंनिया' कायषक्रम  शुरू  ककया , नजसका  उद्देश्य निनजटल अनभगम, निनजटल समावेशन , 
निनजटल सशक ् ‍तीकरण  और  निनजटल नवभाजन  दूर  करने  का  सुननश् ‍चय करते  हुए भारत  को  निनजटल 
रूप से  सशक्त  समाज  और  ज्ञान-आधाररत  अथषव्यवस्था में पररवतर्ततत करना  है । संक्षेप  में, इसका  नमशन  
यह सुनननित  करना  कक ‍ निनजटल प्रौद्योनगककयां प्रत्येक नागररक के  जीवन  में सुधार  करें ; भारत  की  
निनजटल अथषव्यवस्था का  नवस्तार  करें , देश में रोजगार  और  वैनिक  निनजटल प्रौद्योनगककयों का  सृजन  
करें  । 
 
निनजटल इंनिया कायषक्रम  तीन  प्रमुख नवजन  क्षेत्रों पर  क ें कित है, जैसे कक  प्रत्येक नागररक  के  नलए  एक  
मुख्‍य उपयोनगता के  रूप  में निनजटल अवसरंचना , मांग पर  शासन  और  सेवाएं  और  नागररकों  का  
निनजटल सशक ् ‍तीकरण  । यह एक  व्यापक कायषक्रम  है और  इसकी  कई  उपलनधधयां  हाल  ही में वैनिक  
कोनवि महामारी  के  दौरान  भारत  के  लचीलेपन  के  नलए  नजम्मेदार थीं। इस  कायषक्रम  में नवनभन्न क ें िीय 
मंत्रालयों/नवभागों और  राज्यों/क ें ि शानसत  प्रदेशों की  कई  पररयोजनाएं  शानमल  हैं नजनमें  अन्य बातों के  
साथ -साथ  प्रधानमंत्री ग्रामीण निनजटल साक्षरता  अनभयान  (पीएमजीकदशा) योजना  शानमल  है नजसका  
उद्देश्य ग्रामीण भारत  में निनजटल साक्षरता  प्रदान करना  है। कायषक्रम  ने  सरकार  और  नागररकों  के  बीच 
की  दूरी  को  काफी  कम कर  कदया है और  पारदशी  और  भ्रष्टाचार मुक्त तरीक े  से  लाभाथी  को  सीधे  पयाषप्त 
सेवाएं  प्रदान करने  में भी मदद की  है। 
 
इलेक्ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्रालय ( एमईआईटीवाई) फरवरी  2017 से  6 करोड़ ग्रामीण 
पररवारों  को  शानमल  करक े  ग्रामीण भारत  में निनजटल साक्षरता  की  शुरुआत  करने  के  नलए  
पीएमजीकदशा योजना  लागू  कर  रहा  है। अब तक  पीएमजीकदशा योजना  के  कायाषन्वयन  के  नलए  क ु ल  
1488 करोड़ रुपये  जारी  ककए  गए हैं। अब तक , क ु ल  लगभग  5.56 करोड़ उम्मीदवारों को  नामांककत  
ककया  गया है और  4.69 करोड़ उम्मीदवारों को  प्रनशनक्षत ककया  गया है, नजनमें से  3.48 करोड़ 
उम्मीदवारों को  उक्त योजना  के  तहत नवनधवत  प्रमानणत ककया  गया है । 
 
(ग) और  (घ) : निनजटल इंनिया कायषक्रम  के  तहत सभी  प्रमुख योजनाओं  के  प्रभाव का  मूलयांकन  आम 
तौर पर  एक  स्वतंत्र तीसरे  पक्ष  के  माध्यम से  ककया  जाता है, जो ननष्पक्ष  स्वतंत्र मूलयांकन  सुनननित  
करने  के  नलए  योजना  के  कायाषन्वयन  में शानमल  नहीं  होता है। पीएमजीकदशा योजना  के  कदशा-ननदेश  
तीसरे  पक्ष  ( पक्षों ) के  माध्यम से  योजना  के  प्रभाव मूलयांकन  का अध्ययन  नवननधाषररत  करते  हैं। इन  
कदशाननदेशों  के  अनुरूप , भारतीय  प्रौद्योनगकी संस्थान  (आईआईटी), कदलली, सामानजक  नवकास  पररषद  
(सीएसिी ), नई  कदलली  और  भारतीय  लोक  प्रशासन  संस्थान  (आईआईपीए), नई  कदलली  के  माध्यम से  
पीएमजीकदशा योजना  के  प्रभाव मूलयांकन  अध्ययन  आयोनजत ककए  गए थे।

2016, 2017, 2019 और 2020 में पेटेंट णनयमों  में संशोर्न ककया  गया था अब यह 
प्रकक्रयाएं अणर्क संगरित, समयबि, उपभोक्ता अनुक ू ल  और इलेक््‍ट्रॉणनक लेन -िेन के  अनुक ू ल  हैं। 
पेटेंट आवेिन िायर करने  और उन पर  कायधवाही करने  की  प्रकक्रया को  स््‍टाटधअप्‍स और छोटी 
क ं पणनयों  के  णलए  ककफायती  बनाया गया है।

क ं प्‍यूटरीकरि , प्रकक्रया कायधप्रवाह का  पु न र्नधमाधि, डाटाबेस का  उन्‍नयन  और पेटेंट कायाधलयों  को

iii. जनशणक्त का  संवर्धन  
यह णवभाग महाणनयंत्रक, पेटेंट णडजाइन और व्‍यापार  णचह्न (सीजीपीडीटीएम ) कायाधलय  के  साथ 
णमलकर  पेटेंट कायाधलय  की  कमधचाररयों  के  पिों की  णनयणमत  रूप  से समीक्षा करता  है। इस संबंर् 
में पेटेंट और णडजाइन परीक्षकों के  200 पिों के  णलए  भती प्रकक्रया वर्षध 2020 में पूरी  कर  ली  गई 
है। मौजूिा भती णनयमों  के  अनुसार  णवणभन्‍न पिों के  णलए  णनयणमत  रूप  से पिोन्‍नणत की  जाती है।  
णवर्षय वार  प्राप्‍त आवेिनों पर  कायधवाही करने  के  णलए  इनवेंशन  के  16 अलग -अलग  क्षेत्रों में पेटेंट 
परीक्षकों और णनयंत्रकों की  भती की  गई है। णनयुक््‍णत और/अथवा पिोन्‍नणत के  बाि प्रारंणभक प्रणशक्षि 
के  अलावा  आईपी आवेिनों की  जांच और उन्‍हें प्रिान करने / पंजीकरि  करने  के  णलए  कौशल  में 
सुर्ार करने  हेतु पेटेंट और व्‍यापार  णचह्न के  तकनीकी  कमधचाररयों  को  आरजीएनआईआईपीएम , 
नागपुर  और णविेश के  आईपी कायाधलयों  में भी लगातार  प्रणशक्षि/ ररर े शर  कोसध कराये  जाते हैं।   
 
  
iv. शीघ्र जांच  
स्टाटधअपस द्वारा िायर ककये  गए पेटेंट आवेिनों और अपने  पीसीटी आवेिन के  णलए  आईएसए/आईपीईए 
के  रूप  में भारतीय पेटेंट कायाधलय  का  चयन  करने  वाले  आवेिक  के  आवेिनों के  णलए  शीघ्र जांच 
की  सुणवर्ा प्रिान की  गई है। पेटेंट णनयमों  में संशोर्न करक े  किनांक  17.09.2019 से 8 और 
श्रेणियों के  आवेिको  के  पेटेंट आवेिनों को  शीघ्र जांच प्रिाली की  सुणवर्ा प्रिान की  गई है। नई 
श्रेणियों में एसएमई, मणहला  आवेिक , सरकारी  णवभाग, ककसी  क ें द्रीय, प्रांतीय या राज्य अणर्णनयम 
द्वारा स्थाणपत संस्था णजसका  स्वाणमत्व या णनयंत्रि सरकार  के  पास हो, सरकारी  क ं पनी , सरकार  
द्वारा पूिध रूप  से अथवा पयाधप्त रूप  से णवत्त पोणर्षत संस्था और पीपीएच  के  अर्ीन वाले  आवेिक  
शाणमल  है। शीघ्र जांच प्रिाली के  अंतगधत शीघ्र जांच के  अनुरोर् के  तहत िायर ककये  जाने से 1 
वर्षध के  भीतर ज्यािातर आवेिनों पर  पेटेंट प्रिान करने  के  संबंर् में णनिधय ले  णलया  जाता है जबकक  
सामानय जांच प्रकक्रया में क ु छ वर्षध लग  जाते हैं। 
v. फीडबैक  तंत्र  
णहतर्ारकों के  लाभ  के  णलए  आईपी कायाधलयों  की  कायधप्रिाली से संबंणर्त मामलों  के  संबंर् में 
फीडबैक /सुझाव/णशकायतें  िजध कराने  हेतु आईपीओ की  वेबसाइट में एक  तंत्र बनाया गया है। एक  
टीम णहतर्ारकों के  सुझावों/णशकायतों  पर  तुरंत कारधवाई  करती  है और ई-मेल  के  जररये उणचत 
उत््‍तर िेती है।  
vi. स््‍टाटधअप्‍स के  णलए  पहलें  
णवभाग ने स््‍टाटधअप्‍स के  नवप्रयोग और रचनात््‍मकता  को  बढावा िेने के  णलए  "स््‍टाटधअप बौणिक  संपिा 
संरक्षि सुणवर्ा स््‍कीम " (एसआईपीपी ) की  शुरूआत  की  है चूंकक  स््‍टाटधअप्‍स के  पास आईपीआर  संबंर्ी

कायधवाही करने  के  णलए  सीणमत संसार्न और णवशेर्षज्ञता होती है इसणलए  पेटें ट, णडजाइन और 
व्‍यापार  णचह्न में उनक े  आवेिन िायर करने  और तत््‍पश्‍चात उन पर  कायधवाही करने  में स््‍टाटधअप्‍स 
की  सहायता कर ने हेतु वर्षध 2016 में प्रायोणगक आर्ार पर  एक  वर्षध के  णलए  एसआईपीपी  स््‍कीम  
शुरू  की  गई थी। यह स््‍कीम  31 माचध 2020 तक  लागू  थी और इसे माचध 2023 तक  आगे बढाया 
गया है। इस स््‍कीम  के  तहत, सरकार  भी पेटेंट, व्‍यापार  णचह्न अथवा णडजाइन आवेिन िायर करने  
के  णलए  स््‍टाटधअप्‍स की  सहायता करने  वाले  णजतने भी सुणवर्ा प्रिाता/वकील  अथवा एजेंट है/उन की  
संपूिध लागत  वहन  करती  है।  
इस स््‍कीम  के  प्रभावी कायाधन्‍वयन  के  णलए , महाणनयंत्रक, पेटेंट, णडजाइन और व्‍यापार  णचह्न 
(सीजीपीडीटीएम ) द्वारा सुणवर्ा प्रिाताओं को  पैनलबि  ककया  गया है। वतधमान  में 900 से अणर्क 
सुणवर्ा प्रिाता सीजीपीडीटीएम  कायाधलय  में पंजीक ृ त ककए  गए हैं।  
इसक े अलावा  स््‍टाटधअप्‍स को  पेटेंट फाइललंग  शुल्‍क  में 80 प्रणतशत की  छ ू ट िी जाती है। वे अपने  
पेटेंट आवेिनों की  त््‍वररत  जांच की  णवशेर्ष सुणवर्ा का  लाभ  भी उिा सकते  हैं। 
एसआईपीपी  स््‍कीम  आईपीआर  अपनाने  के  णलए  स््‍टाटधअप्‍स के  बीच जागरूकता  को  बढावा िेने और 
सुणवर्ा प्रिाताओं की  सेवाओं के  जररये उच्‍च गुिवत््‍ता वाली  आईपी सेवाओं और संसार्नों तक  पहुं च 
प्रिान करक े  उभरती हुई प्रौद्योणगककयों में उनक े  नवप्रयोगों की  सुरक्षा करने  में सफल  रही है।

है; और  
(ग) णवगत एक  वर्ध के  िौरान उन कम्पणनयों की  संख्या का  ब्यौरा क्या है जो चीन से  पलायन  
कर  भारत आ गई हैं?

(क ) और (ग): ऐसे  कोई  आंकडे  नहीं रखे जाते हैं।  
(ख): सरकार  ने भारत में वृणि  को  बढावा िेने तथा णनवेश आकर्र्धत करने  के  णलए णवणभन्न 
पहलें /स्कीमें शुरू  की  हैं। अणर्क णनवेश को  आसान  बनाने, नवप्रयोग को  बढावा िेने, सवधश्रेष्ठ 
अवसंरचना  का  णनमाधि करने  और भारत को  णवणनमाधि, णिजाइन व नवप्रयोग का  क े न्र 
बनाने के  उद्देश्य से  25 णसतंबर , 2014 को  मेक  इन इंणिया कायधक्रम की  शुरूआत  की  गई 
थी। संभाणवत  णनवेशकों  की  पहचान करने  के  णलए मेक  इन इंणिया कायध योजना के  
कायाधन्वयन, िेश में णनवेश आकर्र्धत करने  के  णलए कायधक्रमों, णशखर सम्मलेनों, रोि शो 
और अन्य संवर्धनात््‍मक  कक्रयाकलाप करने  के  णलए णविेशों में भारतीय णमशनों तथा राज्यों 
की  सहायता  करने  हेतु णनवेश संवर्धन और आउटरीच के  तहत णनरंतर  प्रयास ककए  गए हैं। 
 िेश के  णनवेश वातावरि  में सुर्ार करने  के  णलए उपाय ककए  गए हैं णजसक े  पररिामस््‍वरूप  
णवश््‍व बैंक  की  िूइंग णबजनेस  ररपोटध (िीबीआर) 2020 के  अनुसार  भारत ने णवश््‍व बैंक  की  
ईज़ ऑफ िूइंग णबजनेस  (ईओिीबी) रैंकक ं ग में वर्ध 2014 में 142वें स््‍थान से  63वें स््‍थान 
पर  छलांग लगाई है। उद्योग संवर्धन और आंतररक  व्‍यापार  णवभाग (िीपी आईआईटी) ने 
राज््‍य सरकारों  के  साथ  परामशध करक े  व्‍यवसाय  सुर्ार कायध योजना (बीआरएपी ) के  तहत 
राज््‍यों और क ें र शाणसत  प्रिेशों में व्‍यापक  सुर्ार कायध भी शुरु ककए  हैं। सभी  राज््‍यों/ क ें र 
शाणसत  प्रिेशों को  णनर्ाधररत मानिंिों के  संबंर् में उनक े द्वारा कायाधणन्वत सुर्ारों के  आर्ार

पर  रैंकक ं ग िी जाती है। इस  कायध से  राज््‍यों में व्‍यावसाणयक  माहौल को  बेहतर बनाने में 
मिि णमली है।   
 िेश में णनवेश में तेजी लाने के  णलए सणचवों  के  अणर्कार प्राप्‍त समूह  का  गठन ककया  गया 
है। इसी  प्रकार, णनवेशकों  की  सहायता  करने  तथा क्षेत्रगत और आर्थधक वृणि  को  प्रोत््‍साणहत  
करने  के  णलए क ें र सरकार  के  मंत्रालयों/ णवभागों में पररयोजना  णवकास  प्रकोष्‍ठों (पीिीसी ) 
की  स््‍थापना की  गई है। इसक े  अलावा , णनवेशकों  को  णनवेश के  णलए उनक े प्राथणमकता वाले  
स््‍थल की  पहचान करने  में सहायता  करने  के  णलए जीआईएस -समर्थधत भारती य औद्योणगक 
भूणम बैंक  की  शुरुआत की  गई है। णनवेशकों  को  मंजूरी िेने में सहायता  करने  के  णलए 
णसतंबर , 2021 में राष्‍ट्रीय ससंगल  सवंिो णसस््‍टम (एनएसिब््‍ल्‍यूएस ) की  ऑनलाइन शुरुआत 
भी की  गई है।  
 ‘आत््‍मणनभधर’ बनने के  भारत के  णवजन को  ध्‍यान में र खते हुए तथा भारत की  णवणनमाधि 
क्षमता और णनयाधत को  बढावा िेने के  णलए, णवत््‍तीय वर्ध 2021-22 से  णवणनमाधि के  14 
प्रमुख क्षेत्रों के  णलए उत््‍पािन संबि  प्रोत््‍साहन  (पीएलआई ) स््‍कीम  हेतु क ें रीय बजट 2021-
22 में 1.97 लाख करोड  रुपए  (26 णबणलयन अमरीकी  िॉलर  से  अणर्क) के  पररव्‍यय की  
घोर्िा की  गई है। पीएलआई  स््‍कीमों  की  घोर्िा के  साथ , अगले पांच वर्ों तथा उसक े  
बाि की  अवणर् के  िौरान उत््‍पािन, रोजगार  और आर्थधक वृणि  में काफी  बढोतरी होने की  
संभावना  है। 
 एफिीआई नीणत संबंर्ी सुर्ारों सणहत  सरकार  द्वारा ककए  गए उपायों के  पररिा मस््‍वरूप  िेश 
में वर्ध-िर-वर्ध अणर्क एफिीआई अंतवाधह प्राप्‍त हुआ है। भारत में कोणवि  संबंर्ी व्‍यवर्ानों 
के  बावजूि णवत््‍तीय वर्ध 2020-21 में अब तक  का  सवाधणर्क 81.97 णबणलयन अमेररकी  
िॉलर  (अनंणतम आंकडे ) का  वार्र्धक एफिीआई अंतवाधह िजध ककया  गया। भारत के  एफिीआई 
सं बंर्ी ये रुझान वैणिक  णनवेशकों  के  बीच प्राथणमकता वाले  णनवेश स््‍थल के  रूप  में भारत 
की  स््‍णथणत की  पुणि कर ते हैं। णपछले  सात  णवत््‍तीय वर्ों (2014-21) के  िौरान, भारत 
को  440.27 णबणलयन अमेररकी  िॉलर  एफिीआई अंतवाधह प्राप्‍त हुआ जो कक  णपछले  21 
वर्ों में संसूणचत  एफिीआई (763.83 णबणलयन अमरीकी  िॉलर ) का  58% है। यह भारत 
में अपना व्‍यवसाय  स््‍थाणपत करने  के  प्रणत वैणिक  क ं पणनयों की  बढती रुणच को  िशाधता है। 
 सरकार  ने जारी स््‍कीमों  के  अलावा  भारत में घरेलू  और णविेशी णनवेश को  बढावा िेने के  
णलए णवणभन््‍न अन््‍य किम  उठाए हैं। इनमें उद्योग के  अनुपालन  भार को  कम  करने  के  णलए 
ककए  गए उपाय, राष्‍ट्रीय अवसंरचना  पाइपलाइन , कॉपोरेट  कर  में कमी , एनबीएफसी  और 
बैंकों  की  तरलता  की  समस््‍या का  समार्ान, सावधजणनक  अणर्प्राणि आिेशों, चरिबि  णवणनमाधि 
कायधक्रम (पीएमपी ), और णवणभन््‍न मंत्रालयों की  उत््‍पािन संबि  प्रोत््‍साहन  (पीएलआई ) 
स््‍कीमों  के  जररए घरेलू  णवणनमाधि को  बढावा के  णलए नीणतगत उपाय शाणमल हैं।  
 उपयुधक््‍त के  अलावा , क ें र सरकार  के  अनेक  मंत्रालयों/ णवभागों तथा णवणभन््‍न राज््‍य  सरकारों  
द्वारा स््‍कीमों / कायधक्रमों के  जररए, स्‍मय-समय  पर  कक्रयाकलाप  आयोणजत ककए  जाते हैं। 
उद्योग संवर्धन और आंतररक  व्‍यापार  णवभाग द्वारा इन उपायों का  ब््‍यौरा क ें रीय रूप  से  नहीं 
रखा जाता।

श्री िाइको:  
 
क्या संचार मंत्री यह बताने  की  क ृ पा कर ें गे  ककिः 
(क ) क्‍या द ू रसंचार  किभाग  द्वारा कित्तपोकित 5जी टेस्‍ट-बेड पररयोजना  अंकतम चरण  में पहुँच गई  है; 
(ख) यकद हाुँ, तो  तत्‍संबंधी  ब्‍यौरा  क्‍या है; 
(ग ) ग्राहकों के  किए 5जी प्रौद्योकगकी की  प्रमुख किशेिताए ं क्‍या है और  यह सामान्‍य िोगों  के  किए िागत -िार  
और  िाभ-िार  ककस  हद तक  उपयोगी  होगी ; 
(घ) क्‍या यह किमानों की  आिाजाही के  किए उपयोग  ककए जाने  िािे बेतार  संचार  को  बाकधत  कर े गा  जैसा  कक 
अमरीका  के  किए क ु छ उडानें  रद्द कर  दी गई  थी ं,यकद हाुँ, तो  तत्‍संबंधी  ब्‍यौरा  क्‍या है; 
(ड.) क्‍या यह दे श में ‘6जी प्रौद्योकगकी पररदृश्‍य’ के  किकास  की  आधारकशिा  रखे  जाने  का  मागग  प्रशस्‍त  
कर े गा ; और  
(च) यकद हाुँ, तो  तत्‍संबंधी  ब्‍यौरा  क्‍या है? 
उत्तर 
संचार राज्‍य मंत्री  
(श्री देिुवसंह चौहान) 
 
 
(क ) द ू रसंचार  किभाग द्वारा कित्तपोकित 'स्वदे शी 5जी टेस्ट बेड' पररयोजना  कदनांक  31 कदसंबर , 2021 को  पूरी  
हो गई  है। 
(ख) 'स्वदे शी 5जी टेस्ट बेड' पररयोजना  में सहयोगी  संसथा न  आईआईटी (भारतीय  प्रौद्योकगकी संसथान ) मद्रास, 
आईआईटी कदल्ली, आईआईटी हैदराबाद , आईआईटी बॉम्बे, आईआईटी कानपुर , आईआईएससी  बैंगिोर , 
सोसाइटी  फॉर  एप्लाइड माइक्रोिेि इिेक्ट् र ॉकनक्स इंजीकनयरर ं ग  ए ं ड ररसचग  (समीर ) और  िायरिेस  प्रौद्योकगकी 
उत्क ृ ष्टता क ें द्र (सीईडब्ल्यूआईटी) हैं। यह टेस्ट बेड भारतीय  कशक्षा जगत  और  उद्योग को  5जी िातािरण  में 
अपने  उत्पादों, प्रोटोटाइपों और  एल्गोररदमों को  मान्य कराने  में काफी  सुकिधा प्रदान कर े गा।  
(ग ) 5जी प्रौद्योकगकी इस समय भारत  में तैनात  4जी मोबाइि प्रौद्योकगकी की  अगिी  पीढी है। यह उपभोक्ताओं 
को  4जी की  तुिना  में काफी  अकधक डेटा गकत  प्रदान कर े गी । इसक े  अिािा, यह महत्वपूणग अनुप्रयोगों के  किए 
कम -कििंकबत संचार  प्रदान कर े गी । यह बहत  बडी संख्या में मशीन -टाइप संचार  को  भी सहारा  दे गी । 
(घ) भारत  में 5जी प्रौद्योकगकी सकहत  अंतरागष्टर ीय मोबाइि द ू रसंचा र  (आईएमटी) के  किए खोिे गए  फ्रीक्‍िेंसी बैं डों 
में यह सुकनकित  करने  के  किए पयागप्त गाडग  बैंड हैं ताकक  कोई  िैमाकनकी  हस्तक्षेप न  हो। 
(ङ) और  (च) जी, हाुँ। द ू रसंचार  किभाग ने  6जी पर  एक  प्रौद्योकगकी निाचार  समूह  और  किकभन्न टास्क फोसग 
का  गठन  ककया है कजसमें कशक्षा जगत  और  उद्योग के  सदस्य शाकमि हैं।

(क )  क्‍या सरकार  ने  कनजी क ं पकनय ं के  किए 5जी परीक्षण ं  के  किस्‍तार  की  मंजूरी  दी थी, परीक्षण ं  का  अद्यतन

संचार  राज्‍य मंत्री  
(श्री देिुवसंह चौहान ) 
 
(क ) और  (ख) द ू रसंचार  किभाग (डीओिी) ने  6 माह की  िैधता अिकध के  साथ  5जी प्रौद्य कगकी का  परीक्षण  
करने  के  किए द ू रसंचार  सेिा प्रदाताओं  नामत : मैसस्  भारती  एयरिेि किकमिेड, मैसस्  ररिायंस  कजय  इन्‍फ कॉम  
किकमिेड, मैसस्  ि डाफ न आइकडया किकमिेड क  27 मई 2021 क  और  मैसस्  महानगर  िेिीफ न कनगम किकमिेड 
क  23 जून  2021 क  अनुमकत  प्रदान  कर  दी है। तत्‍पश्‍चात  िीएसपी द्वारा अनुर ध  ककए जाने  पर  अनुमकतय ं  की

उपभोक्ता मामले नर्भाग 
 
राज्य सभा 
अताराांकित प्रश्न सांख्या 1178     
 
किसिा उत्तर शुक्रवार 11 फरवरी, 2022  िो किया िाएगा 
 
खाद्य वस्तुओां िी प्लाकस्िि पैि े किांग ि े  कविल्प       
 
1178. श्री सांिय कसां
ह:  
 
क् या उपभोक् ता मामले, खाद्य और सावविकिि कवतरण मांत्री यह बतािे की कृ पा करेंगे नक:  
 
(क)  क्या सरकार िे खाद्य उत्पादों की प्लानटिक पैक े नजंग क े  नलए नर्कल्पों की योजिा बिाई है;  
(ख)  यनद हां, तो उक्त उद्देश्य क े  नलए कायव योजिा सनहत तत्संबं
धी ब्यौरा क्या है; और   
(ग) यनद िहीं, तो इसक े  क्या कारण हैं? 
 
उत्तर
 
उपभोक्ता मामले, खाद्य और सावविकिि कवतरण राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री अकििी िु मार चौबे) 
 
(क) से (ग): प्लानटिक अपनिष्ट प्रबं
धि नियम, 2016 क े  अंतगवत प्लानटिक पैक े नजंग क े  नलए नर्टताररत 
उत्पादक दानयत्र् पर मसौदा नर्नियमों को पयावर्रण, र्ि और जलर्ायु पररर्तवि मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार द्वारा 6 
अक्तू बर, 2021 को सार्जवनिक परामिव क े  नलए अनधसूनित नकया गया  है। मसौदा नर्नियम में पुि: उपयोग , 
प्लानटिक पैक े नजंग अपनिष्ट क े  ररसाइनक्लंग क े  न्यूितम टतर, ररसाइकल की गई प्लानटिक सामग्री क े उपयोग और 
प्लानटिक अपनिष्ट क े  पयावर्रण अिुरूप प्रबं
धि को अनिर्ायव करिे का अनधदेि नदया गया  है। मसौदा नर्नियम में  
प्लानटिक पैक े नजंग अपनिष्ट की सकुव लर अर्वव्यर्टर्ा को सुदृढ़ करिे, प्लानटिक क े  िए नर्कल्पों क े  नर्कास को 
बढ़ार्ा देिे और निकाऊ प्लानटिक पैक े नजंग की अपेक्षा की गई है।  
 
सूक्ष्म, लघु और मध्यम उद्यम मंत्रालय िे प्लानटिक सामनग्रयों क े  ‘नसंगल य ूज’ क े  टर्ाि पर उसकी र्ैकनल्पक 
सामग्री के प्रयोग को बढ़ार्ा दिे क े  नलए कदम उठाए हैं। िीनत आयोग प्लानटिक का नर्कल्प ढूं
ढ़िे/नर्कनसत करिे 
क े  नलए पहले ही एक सनमनत गनठत कर ि ुका है। पयावर्रण, र्ि और जलर्ायु पररर्तवि मंत्रालय िे निनित नकए गए 
‘नसं
गल यूज’ प्लानटिक का प्रयोग समाप्त करिे क े  नलए राज्यों/सं
घ राज्य क्षेत्रों क े  सार् सां
क े नतक कायव योजिा साझा 
की है।  
 
खाद्य सुरक्षा और मािक (पैक े नजंग) नर्नियम, 2018 क े  अंतगवत, कागज या गत्ता, कांि, धातु या नमश्र धातु और 
प्लानटिक जैसे पदार्ों को खाद्य सं
पक व  सामग्री क े  रूप में टर्ीकृ नत दी गई है।

अिुकू ल और प्लानटिक पैक े नजंग सामग्री क े  नर्कल्पों को समायोनजत करिे क े  उपाय नकए हैं:-

सामग्री (कागज और गत्ता सामग्री/कां
ि/धातु और नमश्र धातु) क े  उपयोग की अिुमनत ;  
iv. खाद्य सं
पक व  एप्लीक े िि क े  नलए ररसाइकल की गई पेि रेनसि क े  टर्ीकृ नत मािदंड क े  नलए उनित नदिा -
निदेि क े  सार् खाद्य सं
पक व  सामग्री क े  रूप में ररसाइनकल की गई प्लानटिक क े  उपयोग की अिुमनत।

भारत  सरकार  
इलेक ्‍ट्रॉननकी और  सूचना  प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्रालय 
राज्‍य सभा  
अतारांककत  प्रश्न संख्या 1190 
नजसका  उत्तर 11 फरवरी , 2022 को  कदया जाना  है । 
22 माघ, 1943 (शक)  
  
सेमीक ं डक ् ‍टसस  नवननमासण  को  बढावा देना  
 
1190    श्री महेश पोद्दार : 
 
 क्या इलेक ्‍ट्रॉननकी और  सूचना  प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्री यह बताने  की  क ृ पा करेंगे  कक : 
 
(क)    इलेक ्‍ट्रोननक कलपुजों  और  सेमीक ं डक ् ‍टसस  के  नवननमासण  संवधसन  की  योजना  ( एसपीईसीएस ) की  
शुरूआत  से  सरकार  द्वारा ककतना  नवत्‍तीय प्रोत्‍साहन  प्रदान ककया  गया है, यकद हां, तो तत्‍संबंधी  
ब्‍यौरा  क्‍या हैं;  
 
(ख)   आज तक  यह योजना  ककतना  नया  ननवेश  ला पाने  तथा रोजगार सृनजत  करने  में सक्षम रही  है, 
यकद हां, तो तत्‍संबंधी  राज्‍य-वार  ब्‍यौरा  क्‍या हैं; और  
 
(ग)       वे क्षेत्र कौन -से  हैं नजन्‍हें नचप्‍स  की  कमी  के  चलते घाटा उठाना  पडा और  प्राक ्‍कनलत  
ककतना  घाटा हुआ और  चीन  से  संसाधनों  की  पूती करने  हेतु क्‍या उपाय ककए  गए हैं, यकद हां तो 
तत्‍संबंधी  ब्‍यौरा  क्‍या है?  
 
उत्तर

(ख)  यलद हां , तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है, यलद नहीं, तो इसक े  क्या कारण है; और  
(ग)  इस पररव्यय में वर्ा-वार और राज्य -वार लकतना लनवेश लकया गया है और उक्त क े  कायाान्वयन की 
क्या प्रगलत हुई है? 
 
उत्तर 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री प्रहलाद कसांह पटेल) 
 
(ि) से (ग): भारत की लवलनमााण क्षमताओं को बढाने और लनयाातों में वृद्धि करने क े  ललए 10,900 करोड़ 
रुपए क े  पररव्यय क े  साथ मंत्रालय द्वारा "आत्म लनभार भारत अलभयान " क े  भाग क े  रूप में खाद्य प्रसंस्करण 
उद्योग क े  ललए उत्पादन ललंक्ड प्रोत्साहन योजना (पीएलआईएसएफपीआई) तैयार की गई है। इस योजना 
क े  तीन व्यापक घटक हैं। पहला घटक चार प्रमुख खाद्य उत्पाद खंडों अथाात रेडी ट ू  क ु क/ रेडी ट ू  ईट 
(आरटीसी/ आरटीई) लजसमें बाजरा -आधाररत खाद्य पदाथा , प्रसंस्क ृ त फल और सद्धियां, समुद्री उत्पाद 
और मोजेरेला  पनीर क े  लवलनमााण को प्रोत्सालहत करने से संबंलधत है। द ू सरा घटक मुक्त रेंज - अंडे, पोल्ट् र ी 
मांस और अंडा उत्पादों सलहत उपरोक्त सभी चार खाद्य उत्पाद खंडों में एसएमई क े  अलभनव/ जैलवक 
उत्पादों को प्रोत्सालहत करने क े  ललए है।  तीसरा घटक मजबूत भारतीय ब्ांडों क े  उद्भव को प्रोत्सालहत 
करने क े  ललए लवदेशों में ब्ांलडंग और लवपणन क े  ललए समथान से संबंलधत है। 
 
योजना क े  लदशालनदेश लदनांक 2 मई, 2021 को अलधसूलचत लकए गए थे और लदनांक 2 मई, 2021 को 
योजना क े  तहत आवेदन आमंलत्रत करने क े  ललए ईओआई जारी की गई थी , लजसमें आवेदन लवंडो क े  बंद 
होने की लतलथ लदनांक 24 जून, 2021 थी। श्रेणी- I क े  तहत क ु ल 60 आवेदक, श्रेणी- II क े  अंतगात 12 
आवेदक और श्रेणी- III क े  तहत 71 आवेदकों का हाल ही में चयन लकया गया है।

1221.   श्री ि े . आर. एन. राजेश ि ु मार:  
 
 क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मांत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे लक:  
(ि)  क्या सरकार ने देश भर में 2 लाख सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण यूलनटों को ऋण से जुडी राजसहायता प्रदान करने 
क े  ललए 10,000 करोड रुपये क े  पररव्यय से सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यमों को औपचाररक रूप देने क े  ललए 
कोई योजना प्रस्तालवत/शुरू की है ;  
(ख)  यलद हां , तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है;   
(ग)  क्या सरकार ने देश भर में उद्योग क े  बुलनयादी ढांचे को सुदृढ़ बनाने क े  ललए कोई लक्ष्य लनधााररत लकया है; और  
(घ) यलद हां, तो इस संबंध में राज्य सरकारों को दी गई लवत्तीय सहायता सलहत तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है?    
 
उत्तर 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री प्रहलाद कसांह पटेल) 
 
(ि) और  (ख): जी हां , खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग मंत्रालय (एमओएफपीआई) देश में सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यमों 
क े  उन्नयन क े  ललए लवत्तीय, तकनीकी और व्यावसालयक सहायता प्रदान करने क े  ललए एक क ें द्रीय प्रायोलजत प्रधानमंत्री 
सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यम उन्नयन (पीएमएफएमई) योजना कायाान्वित कर रहा है। यह योजना 10,000 करोड रुपये 
क े  पररव्यय क े  साथ वर्ा 2020-21 से 2024-25 तक पांच वर्ा की अवलध क े  ललए प्रचालनरत है। मौजूदा यूलनटों क े  
उन्नयन अथवा व्यन्वियों क े  ललए नई सूक्ष्म यूलनटों की स्थापना क े  ललए सहायता 10.00 लाख रुपये क े  अलधकतम 
अनुदान क े  साथ 35% की दर से क्र े लिट ललंक्ि अनुदान क े  माध्यम से प्रदान की जाती है। यह स्कीम स्वयं सहायता 
समूहों (एसएचजी)/लकसान उत्पादक संगठनों (एफपीओ)/सहकारी सलमलतयों की खाद्य प्रसंस्करण यूलनटों को 35% 
की दर से क्र े लिट ललंक्ि सन्वििी, स्व-सहायता समूहों , इनक्यूबेशन क ें द्रों, सामान्य अवसंरचना, लवपणन और ब्ांलिंग 
तथा क्षमता लनमााण क े  ललए प्रारन्विक पूंजी क े  ललए भी सहायता प्रदान करती है।

 क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मांत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे लक:

(ख)  भारत में खाद्य प्रसंस्करण में लकन-लकन लदग्गज क ं पलनयों ने लनवेश लकया है; और

(डीपीआईआईटी) द्वारा की जाती है। अप्रैल 2000 से नवंबर 2021 तक खाद्य प्रसंस्करण क्षेत्र में क ु ल 
एफडीआई 10.88 लबललयन अमेररकी डॉलर था।  
(ख): डीपीआईआईटी से प्राप्त जानकारी क े  अनुसार, भारतीय खाद्य प्रसंस्करण क्षेत्र में लनवेश करने 
वाली क ु छ प्रमुख क ं पलनयों बी.एस.ए. इंटरनेशनल , बेल्जियम; क ै डबरी श्वेपेप्स मॉरीशस लललमटेड,
